title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. It can be applied to both convex and non-convex functions.

title: Convex vs Non-Convex Functions
text: A convex function has a single global minimum, while a non-convex function may have multiple local minima. Gradient descent can be used on both types of functions, but it may get stuck in local minima for non-convex functions.

title: Gradient Descent on Convex Functions
text: When using gradient descent on a convex function, the algorithm is guaranteed to converge to the global minimum.

title: Gradient Descent on Non-Convex Functions
text: When using gradient descent on a non-convex function, the algorithm may converge to a local minimum instead of the global minimum.
